title: Voters rebuff data centers in every ballot measure except one during the 2026 midterms
summary: Voters in the states at the heart of the AI data center boom pushed back on the buildout on Election Night.
title_en: Voters rebuff data centers in every ballot measure except one during the 2026 midterms
title_zh: 2026年中期选举：除一项外，所有数据中心公投均遭选民否决
summary_en: Voters in states central to the AI data center boom rejected the buildout on Election Night, with every ballot measure failing except one, signaling growing local resistance to AI infrastructure expansion.
summary_zh: 在AI数据中心热潮核心州，选民于选举夜否决了数据中心建设，除一项外所有公投均未通过，显示地方对AI基础设施扩张的抵制日益增强。

title: Texas was the new epicenter of the AI data center buildout. That might be kaput.
summary: Texas is the fastest-growing data center market in the US and ground zero for Big Tech’s largest AI buildouts. But the blue wave that swept the Lone Star State may jeopardize that position. Democrat James Talarico won the US Senate seat against Ken Paxton. Gina Hinojosa won the race for governor against the Republican incumbent,…
title_en: Texas AI Data Center Boom May Face Political Headwinds
title_zh: 德州AI数据中心热潮或因政治变局受阻
summary_en: Texas, the fastest-growing US data center market and hub for Big Tech AI buildouts, may see its position threatened after Democratic wins in the Senate and governor races.
summary_zh: 德州作为美国增长最快的数据中心市场和大型科技公司AI建设重地，在民主党赢得参议院和州长选举后，其地位可能受到威胁。

title: Figma sinks after earnings beat as company prioritizes long-term growth with AI changes
summary: Figma is letting clients use more artificial intelligence features for the same price. The company would like the move to boost results in the long term.
title_en: Figma Shares Fall Despite Earnings Beat as It Prioritizes Long-Term AI Growth
title_zh: Figma财报超预期但股价下跌，优先布局AI长期增长
summary_en: Figma beat earnings estimates but its stock dropped after the company said it will give clients more AI features at the same price, prioritizing long-term growth over near-term results.
summary_zh: Figma财报超出预期，但股价下跌，因公司表示将以相同价格提供更多AI功能，优先考虑长期增长而非短期业绩。

title: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
summary: During its busiest week last quarter, Uber said only 4 people booked a ride using an AI agent.
title_en: Almost no one uses AI agents to book their Uber, company says
title_zh: 优步称几乎无人用AI智能体叫车
summary_en: Uber revealed that during its busiest week last quarter, only four people booked a ride using an AI agent, suggesting consumer adoption of agentic booking remains negligible despite industry hype.
summary_zh: 优步透露，上季度最繁忙的一周内仅有4人通过AI智能体叫车，显示尽管行业热炒，消费者对智能体预订的采用率仍极低。

summary_en: Google launched its Data Agent Kit, a toolkit for building data agents, with security split into Skill-level and IAM-level safeguards to control agent access and actions.
summary_zh: 谷歌正式发布 Data Agent Kit，用于构建数据智能体，其安全防护分为 Skill 层与 IAM 层，以管控智能体的访问权限与操作行为。

title: OpenAI is already trying to shape the 2028 election
summary: OpenAI’s Chris Lehane wants AI to define the 2028 election, proposing a new social contract that could benefit Americans while also advancing the AI giant’s own business interests.
title_en: OpenAI Is Already Trying to Shape the 2028 Election
title_zh: OpenAI已着手影响2028年大选
summary_en: OpenAI's Chris Lehane wants AI to define the 2028 election, proposing a new social contract that could benefit Americans while also advancing the AI giant's business interests.
summary_zh: OpenAI的克里斯·莱汉希望AI成为2028年大选的核心议题，提出一项新社会契约，既可能惠及美国民众，也有助于推进这家AI巨头的商业利益。

title: Meta acquires AI coding startup Conductor
summary: The startup allows software engineers to deploy teams of agents to work on various aspects of a project simultaneously.
title_en: Meta Acquires AI Coding Startup Conductor
title_zh: Meta收购AI编程初创公司Conductor
summary_en: Meta has acquired Conductor, a startup whose platform lets software engineers deploy teams of AI agents to work on different parts of a project simultaneously. Terms of the deal were not disclosed.
summary_zh: Meta已收购初创公司Conductor，其平台允许软件工程师部署多个人工智能代理团队，同时处理项目的不同部分。交易条款未披露。

summary_zh: DuckDuckGo正争取对谷歌AI限制不满的学校，向教育工作者推荐其搜索引擎及关闭AI功能的选项。

summary: Open source models are becoming more mainstream as enterprises, governments and startups alike rely on the promise of lower costs, more control, and more flexibility. But as increasingly capable models become more freely available, how do companies capture value? And with Chinese open models gaining ground, can American players keep up? On this episode of […]
title_en: Open Source AI Booms as Hugging Face Explains Who Profits
title_zh: 开源AI蓬勃发展，Hugging Face解析谁在获利
summary_en: Open source models are going mainstream as enterprises, governments and startups seek lower costs, control and flexibility. Hugging Face examines how companies capture value and whether US players can keep pace with rising Chinese open models.
summary_zh: 随着企业、政府和初创公司追求更低成本、更多控制和灵活性，开源模型正走向主流。Hugging Face探讨企业如何从中获利，以及美国厂商能否跟上中国开源模型的崛起。

title_zh: Nothing预告下月发布无屏AI设备

title: Google responds to political backlash over removing search from schools that ban AI
summary: After elected officials voiced outrage over Google turning off search at schools that ban AI, the company said search can be turned back on with AI Overviews.
title_en: Google Reverses School Search Shutdown After Political Backlash
title_zh: 谷歌在政治反弹后恢复被禁AI学校的搜索服务
summary_en: After elected officials criticized Google for disabling search at schools banning AI, the company said search can be re-enabled with AI Overviews, easing a political fight over AI in classrooms.
summary_zh: 在民选官员批评谷歌关闭禁用AI学校的搜索服务后，该公司表示可通过AI概览重新开启搜索，缓解了围绕课堂AI的政治争议。

title: ChatGPT will now make you animated GIFs
summary: ChatGPT can now create GIFs using a prompt or a photo uploaded to the AI chatbot. The update, which is rolling out alongside OpenAI's new Images 2.6 model, allows you to adjust the GIF's animation speed, edit individual frames, and share it with others. Before this change, ChatGPT couldn't natively generate GIFs in a single […]
title_en: ChatGPT Now Generates Animated GIFs With New Images 2.6 Model
title_zh: ChatGPT借助全新Images 2.6模型支持生成动态GIF
summary_en: ChatGPT can now create animated GIFs from a prompt or uploaded photo, rolling out with OpenAI's Images 2.6 model. Users can adjust animation speed, edit individual frames, and share results, a first for native GIF generation.
summary_zh: ChatGPT现可依据提示词或上传照片生成动态GIF，该功能随OpenAI Images 2.6模型一同推出，支持调整动画速度、编辑单帧并分享，此前无法原生生成GIF。
